headline: Destry Opens Up on Reasons Behind BI Rate Hike Decision, Check It Out!
summary: Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti said the policy rate increase was a pre-emptive measure against economic pressures expected in the future.
why: Bank Indonesia is the central bank of Indonesia, and its policy rate sets borrowing costs across the economy and influences the rupiah and local bond yields.
original_headline: Destry Buka-Bukaan Alasan di Balik Keputusan Kenaikan BI Rate, Simak!
